goal: Compose family-set recognition, abstention, Order 2, and knob recovery without mutating audio, then test cross-domain physical limits.

architecture.abstention: uncertain family sets stop before order and control delivery

model.threshold_policy: one zero-observed-error threshold per predicted family set

development.data: DAFx real plus reference, alternate, stress, and pedalboard synthetic domains; IDMT device-6/7 train and device-8 calibration/validation

idmt_round0.decision: Consumed failure evidence; never reused as a gate4 sealed claim.

asrnn_rat.evaluator_note: Two model misclassifications were also labelled runtime errors by the original evaluator; the evaluator was fixed after the immutable rejected report. The recognition and knob failures remain decisive.

decision: Admit gate4 only as an optional development chain package. Do not claim physical-pedal knob fidelity or release qualification. Generic canonical controls require a named-device adapter before delivery to a real pedal model.
next: Add a device adapter boundary and use the existing RAT-specific inverse package as the first adapter; obtain a new untouched device/session split before any physical release claim.
